about: More church windows (two-storey ones: lower lights and head), as church_windows_uk_01.
evidence: List text: 'Most of the windows have traceried lights of Decorated and Perpendicular style, all restorations, there are 2 smaller 3-light windows within square frames.'
List text: 'The main feature is a round-headed bell-stage opening, with rusticated sides and voussoirs'

Looked at, not copied (Commons): the west front ('All Saints Church, Odiham 03'): three-light Perpendicular windows in the aisle gables and the tower, pale stone tracery; stained glass in the east window ('nave 02').

Measured on the west front photo ('All Saints Church, Odiham 03', looked at only): the aisle windows are about 0.4 of the gable's width and rise from a third of the wall's height almost to the eaves: two storeys here, the lights below, the head above.
